Risk Description: Unauthorised or commercially inappropriate purchase orders may be issued to suppliers.
Control Objective: Ensure high-value purchase orders are authorised and supported before release.
Control Description: Before release to the supplier, the Procurement Manager reviews each purchase order above CHF 25,000 against the approved requisition, budget code and supplier quotation. Any unsupported difference is rejected. The approved workflow record and attachments are retained in SAP Ariba under the purchase order number.
Evidence: SAP Ariba approval workflow, approved requisition and supplier quotation

Risk Description: Kreditorenrechnungen könnten ohne gültige Bestellung oder ohne Leistungsempfang verbucht werden.
Control Objective: Sicherstellen, dass nur berechtigte und rechnerisch korrekte Kreditorenrechnungen verbucht werden.
Control Description: Die Kreditorenbuchhaltung vergleicht vor jeder Verbuchung die Rechnung mit Bestellung und Wareneingang. Abweichungen ab CHF 0.01 werden geklärt und dokumentiert. Der Dreiwegabgleich sowie die Klärungsnachweise werden im elektronischen Rechnungsarchiv unter der Belegnummer aufbewahrt.
Evidence: Dreiwegabgleich und Klärungsnachweise im elektronischen Rechnungsarchiv

Risk Description: Blocked invoices may remain unresolved, resulting in late fees or inaccurate liabilities.
Control Objective: Resolve aged blocked invoices before payment deadlines are missed.
Control Description: Each Monday before the payment proposal is prepared, the Accounts Payable Supervisor reviews all blocked invoices outstanding for more than two business days and assigns each item for resolution. Items still unresolved by Thursday are escalated to the Financial Accounting Manager.

Risk Description: Unberechtigte Änderungen an Kreditorenstammdaten könnten zu Fehl- oder Betrugszahlungen führen.
Control Objective: Nur vollständig belegte und unabhängig genehmigte Änderungen an Kreditorenstammdaten zulassen.
Control Description: Vor der Aktivierung einer neuen oder geänderten Bankverbindung vergleicht der Leiter Kreditorenbuchhaltung jeden Antrag mit dem unterzeichneten Stammdatenformular und dem dokumentierten Rückruf an eine unabhängig beschaffte Telefonnummer. Unvollständige Anträge werden zurückgewiesen. Antrag, Rückrufprotokoll und elektronisches Visum werden im IKS-Ordner Kreditorenstamm abgelegt.
Evidence: Stammdatenformular, Rückrufprotokoll und elektronisches Visum im IKS-Ordner Kreditorenstamm

Risk Description: Duplicate supplier invoices may be paid.
Control Objective: Identify and resolve potential duplicate invoices before payment.
Control Description: Each Friday, the Accounts Payable Manager reviews the duplicate-payment exception report and investigates items considered unusual before the next payment run. The annotated report and supporting correspondence are retained in the P2P controls SharePoint folder by week.
Evidence: Annotated exception report and correspondence in the P2P controls SharePoint folder

Risk Description: Excessive or unauthorised customer credit limits may cause bad-debt losses.
Control Objective: Ensure customer credit limit changes are supported and independently approved.
Control Description: Before a revised credit limit becomes effective, the Credit Manager reviews every request against the current credit report, payment history and delegated approval matrix. Requests lacking required approval are rejected. The signed request, credit report and workflow approval are retained in the customer record in Salesforce.
Evidence: Signed request, credit report and Salesforce workflow approval

Risk Description: Überfällige Debitorenforderungen könnten nicht rechtzeitig bearbeitet oder wertberichtigt werden.
Control Objective: Überfällige Forderungen rechtzeitig erkennen und bearbeiten.
Control Description: Am dritten Arbeitstag nach jedem Monatsabschluss stellt der Leiter Debitorenbuchhaltung sicher, dass überfällige Debitoren angeschaut und bedeutende Fälle weiterverfolgt werden. Die kommentierte Liste wird im IKS-Ordner Debitoren nach Monat abgelegt.
Evidence: Kommentierte Debitorenliste im monatlichen IKS-Ordner Debitoren

Risk Description: Completed clinical services may not be transferred completely to the billing system.
Control Objective: Ensure all completed clinical services are transferred to patient billing.
Control Description: Every business day by 10:00, the Billing Systems Analyst reconciles the count and CHF value of completed services in the clinical system to records accepted by the billing interface. Any count difference or CHF variance above CHF 1 is investigated. The signed reconciliation and interface logs are retained in the O2C SharePoint folder by date.
Evidence: Signed reconciliation and interface logs in the O2C SharePoint folder

Risk Description: Aufträge könnten trotz überschrittenem Kreditlimit oder stark überfälligen Forderungen freigegeben werden.
Control Objective: Aufträge mit unzulässigem Kreditrisiko automatisch sperren.
Control Description: Bei der Auftragserfassung sperrt SAP automatisch jeden Auftrag, wenn das genehmigte Kreditlimit überschritten ist oder eine Forderung mehr als 30 Tage überfällig ist. Nur der Kreditmanager kann die Sperre über einen dokumentierten Workflow aufheben. Systemprotokolle und Freigaben werden sieben Jahre im SAP-Belegarchiv aufbewahrt.
Evidence: Systemprotokoll der Kreditsperre und Workflow-Freigaben im SAP-Belegarchiv

Risk Description: The accounts receivable subledger may not agree with the general ledger.
Control Objective: Ensure accounts receivable balances are complete and accurately recorded in the general ledger.
Control Description: The Accounts Receivable Manager reconciles the accounts receivable subledger to the general ledger and investigates every difference above CHF 100. The signed reconciliation and supporting detail are retained in the month-end close folder in BlackLine.
Evidence: Signed reconciliation and supporting detail in BlackLine

Risk Description: Cash transactions or bank balances may be incomplete or inaccurate.
Control Objective: Ensure bank balances and cash transactions agree with the general ledger.
Control Description: Within two business days after each month-end, the Treasury Accounting Manager reviews every bank reconciliation, investigates unmatched items above CHF 100 or older than two business days, and signs the reconciliation. The signed reconciliation, bank statement and investigation support are retained in BlackLine by bank account and period.
Evidence: Signed reconciliation, bank statement and investigation support in BlackLine

Risk Description: Unberechtigte oder fehlerhafte Zahlungen könnten an die Bank übermittelt werden.
Control Objective: Sicherstellen, dass Zahlungsdateien vor der Bankübermittlung vollständig und genehmigt sind.
Control Description: Vor jeder Bankübermittlung vergleicht der Treasury Manager die Zahlungssumme und die Anzahl Zahlungen manuell mit dem genehmigten Zahlungsvorschlag. Jede Abweichung wird zurückgewiesen. Der unterzeichnete Vergleich und das elektronische Visum der Zahlungsfreigabe werden im Treasury-IKS-Ordner nach Laufnummer abgelegt.
Evidence: Unterzeichneter Vergleich und elektronisches Visum im Treasury-IKS-Ordner

Risk Description: Payment files may be altered or released without independent authorisation.
Control Objective: Require independent approval of payment batches before bank release.
Control Description: For each payment run, the Treasury Analyst prepares the bank file, compares the batch total and beneficiary count to the approved payment proposal, and then provides the sole final approval in the e-banking portal before release. Any difference is rejected. The proposal, comparison and bank approval log are retained in the Treasury SharePoint folder by batch ID.
Evidence: Payment proposal, batch comparison and bank approval log in Treasury SharePoint

Risk Description: Foreign exchange deals may be recorded with incorrect terms or may not be authorised.
Control Objective: Confirm each foreign exchange deal independently against the counterparty confirmation.
Control Description: By noon on the business day following trade date, the Treasury Operations Manager compares every counterparty confirmation to the trade ticket for currency pair, buy and sell amounts, rate, value date and bank account. Any mismatch is escalated to the Head of Treasury before settlement. The matched confirmation and escalation evidence are retained in the treasury management system under the deal number.
Evidence: Matched counterparty confirmation and escalation evidence in the treasury management system

Risk Description: Errors or unauthorised cash movements may remain undetected.
Control Objective: Detect unresolved differences between bank statements and accounting records.
Control Description: Within two business days after each week-end, Finance reviews the bank reconciliation and investigates every unreconciled item above CHF 50. The signed reconciliation and investigation support are retained in BlackLine by account and week.
Evidence: Signed reconciliation and investigation support in BlackLine

Risk Description: Balance sheet accounts may contain unsupported or stale items.
Control Objective: Ensure material balance sheet accounts are reconciled and reconciling items are resolved.
Control Description: By the fifth business day after month-end, the Financial Accounting Manager reviews reconciliations for all accounts classified as high risk. Differences above CHF 100 and items older than 30 days must include documented resolution actions and due dates. The reviewer signs electronically, and the reconciliation and support are retained in BlackLine.
Evidence: Electronically signed reconciliations and supporting documents in BlackLine

Risk Description: Intercompany-Salden könnten zwischen Konzerngesellschaften abweichen und die Konsolidierung verfälschen.
Control Description: Bis zum vierten Arbeitstag nach jedem Monatsabschluss stimmt der Senior Group Accountant sämtliche Intercompany-Salden mit den Gegenparteien ab. Differenzen über CHF 1'000 werden untersucht und vor der Konsolidierung bereinigt oder dokumentiert genehmigt. Abstimmung, Gegenparteibestätigung und Visum werden in der Konsolidierungsablage nach Periode aufbewahrt.
Evidence: Abstimmung, Gegenparteibestätigung und Visum in der Konsolidierungsablage

Risk Description: Consolidation adjustments may be incomplete or inaccurate.
Control Objective: Identify unsupported or inaccurate consolidation adjustments.
Control Description: The Group Reporting Manager reviews the consolidation adjustment report and investigates every manual adjustment above CHF 5,000 and every adjustment posted to goodwill accounts. The annotated report and supporting analysis are retained in the consolidation close folder in CCH Tagetik.
Evidence: Annotated adjustment report and supporting analysis in CCH Tagetik

Risk Description: Unausgeglichene Buchungen oder Buchungen in geschlossene Perioden könnten das Hauptbuch verfälschen.
Control Objective: Unausgeglichene Buchungen und Buchungen in geschlossene Perioden automatisch verhindern.
Control Description: Bei jeder Buchung prüft SAP automatisch, ob Soll und Haben übereinstimmen und ob die Buchungsperiode offen ist. Bei einer Differenz ab CHF 0.01 oder einer geschlossenen Periode wird die Buchung blockiert. Das Systemprotokoll der abgewiesenen Buchung wird im SAP-Belegarchiv gespeichert.
Evidence: Systemprotokoll der abgewiesenen Buchungen im SAP-Belegarchiv

Risk Description: Inappropriate or unsupported manual journals may be posted.
Control Objective: Ensure manual journals are valid and approved before posting.
Control Description: Before each manual journal is posted, the Financial Controller ensures that the journal is appropriate and approves it in the workflow. The journal entry, attachments and approval record are retained in SAP under the document number.
Evidence: Journal entry, attachments and workflow approval in SAP

Risk Description: Unauthorised users may gain remote access to the clinical and financial network.
Control Objective: Prevent remote network access without valid multi-factor authentication.
Control Description: At every remote login attempt, Microsoft Entra ID automatically blocks access unless the user provides a valid password and completes the registered second authentication factor. Successful and blocked authentication events are retained for 365 days in Microsoft Sentinel.
Evidence: Authentication and blocked-access logs retained in Microsoft Sentinel

Risk Description: Nicht mehr benötigte privilegierte Berechtigungen könnten unberechtigte Systemänderungen ermöglichen.
Control Objective: Nicht benötigte oder unvereinbare privilegierte Berechtigungen zeitnah entfernen.
Control Description: Bis zum fünften Arbeitstag nach jedem Quartalsende überprüft der Leiter Informationssicherheit sämtliche privilegierten Benutzerkonten. Konten inaktiver Mitarbeitender, Konten ohne gültige Genehmigung und seit mehr als 30 Tagen unbenutzte Administratorkonten werden zur sofortigen Sperrung gemeldet.

Risk Description: Excessive privileged access may permit unauthorised changes to financial or clinical systems.
Control Objective: Confirm that privileged access remains necessary and approved.
Control Description: Each 15 December, the Information Security Manager reviews all privileged accounts and investigates accounts with no valid approval, no use for more than 30 days or an owner who has left the company. The signed review and remediation tickets are retained in ServiceNow under the annual access campaign.
Evidence: Signed access review and remediation tickets in ServiceNow

Risk Description: Emergency system changes may be unauthorised, inadequately tested or harmful to production processing.
Control Objective: Ensure every emergency production change is retrospectively reviewed and approved.
Control Description: Within one business day after implementation, the IT Change Manager reviews every emergency change for an approved incident reference, documented testing, implementation results and segregation between developer and deployer. Missing items are escalated to the CIO and remediated within two business days. The signed review and supporting records are retained in the ServiceNow change ticket.
Evidence: Signed review, test results and approval records in the ServiceNow change ticket

Risk Description: Users may retain access that is excessive or incompatible with their job responsibilities.
Control Objective: Remove unnecessary or conflicting application access.
Control Description: By the tenth business day after each quarter-end, the Application Access Manager manually reviews the complete user-access listing against current HR job data and the segregation-of-duties matrix. Access belonging to terminated staff, access without a current role requirement and identified conflicts are removed within five business days. The signed listing and removal tickets are retained in ServiceNow by campaign.
Evidence: Signed access listing and removal tickets in ServiceNow

Risk Description: Payroll may contain inaccurate or unauthorised employee payments.
Control Objective: Identify material or unexpected payroll changes before payment release.
Control Description: Two business days before each monthly payroll release, the Payroll Manager compares gross pay by employee to the prior month and investigates variances above CHF 100 or 5%, plus all new starters, leavers and bank-account changes. The signed variance report and supporting explanations are retained in the payroll close folder in Workday.
Evidence: Signed variance report and supporting explanations in Workday

Risk Description: Nicht genehmigte oder fehlerhafte Lohnmutationen könnten in die Lohnabrechnung einfliessen.
Control Objective: Sicherstellen, dass Lohnmutationen vollständig genehmigt und richtig verarbeitet sind.
Control Description: Die Personalabteilung vergleicht vor jeder Lohnfreigabe sämtliche Lohnmutationen mit den genehmigten Personalformularen. Jede Differenz ab CHF 1 wird vor der Freigabe geklärt. Die unterzeichnete Abstimmung und die Formulare werden im geschützten Lohn-IKS-Ordner nach Abrechnungsmonat abgelegt.
Evidence: Unterzeichnete Abstimmung und genehmigte Personalformulare im geschützten Lohn-IKS-Ordner

Risk Description: Incorrect or unauthorised payroll amounts may be released to employees.
Control Objective: Ensure the payroll payment file agrees with approved payroll records before release.
Control Description: For every monthly payroll run, the Payroll Manager prepares the payroll-to-general-ledger reconciliation, investigates all differences above CHF 10 and then approves the same reconciliation and payment file for bank release. The reconciliation, payroll register and bank approval log are retained in the restricted payroll SharePoint folder by month.
Evidence: Payroll reconciliation, payroll register and bank approval log in restricted SharePoint
System(s): Workday, SAP S/4HANA, e-banking portal, SharePoint

Risk Description: Ausgetretene Mitarbeitende könnten nach dem Austrittsdatum weiterhin auf Unternehmenssysteme zugreifen.
Control Objective: Systemzugriffe ausgetretener Mitarbeitender per Austrittsdatum automatisch sperren.
Control Description: Zum im Personalsystem erfassten Austrittszeitpunkt übermittelt Workday automatisch eine Deaktivierungsanweisung an Microsoft Entra ID. Microsoft Entra ID sperrt das Benutzerkonto spätestens innerhalb von 15 Minuten. Schnittstellen- und Sperrprotokolle werden 365 Tage in Microsoft Sentinel aufbewahrt.
Evidence: Schnittstellen- und Sperrprotokolle in Microsoft Sentinel
System(s): Workday, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Sentinel

Risk Description: Unauthorised changes to employee bank or salary data may result in incorrect payroll payments.
Control Objective: Detect unauthorised changes to sensitive employee master data.
Control Description: On the third business day of each month, the HR Systems Manager reviews the employee master-data change report and investigates every salary variance above CHF 50 and every bank-account change without an approved HR form.
